runtime_replay.policy: Original response_body member order plus Python 3.11 left-to-right float sums. Exact forecast equality retained; no numerical tolerance or output modification.

limits: Identical archived original materials, questions, scale and decision registry within each pair.
Evidence packing is the intended changed variable. Original capture versions differ across cases.
Three dates lack official API scale and question identity; research distributions cannot establish submission validity.
Range metric is bounded normalized CRPS, categorical metric is sum Brier; neither is Metaculus Peer or Baseline score.
Censored labels retain tail identity, not fabricated point outcomes.
Historical captures/model knowledge can expose outcomes. This is not a leakage-free historical backtest.
One stochastic replicate per arm; no model repeat variance estimate and no production promotion.
